description: Work out customer churn for a month: customers lost over customers at the start, with retention, the same rate compounded over a year, average customer lifetime and, given revenue per customer, the revenue lost. Send numbers only (percentages as 5 for 5%). Answers a headline, the figures behind it and notes. Arithmetic on your own numbers, not financial advice. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

arpa.description: Average revenue per customer, per month Optional.

currency.description: The sign money is written with; "none" for bare numbers. Default "$".

lost.description: Customers who cancelled during it. Only customers who were there at the start.

start.description: Customers at the start of the month

name: calculate_churn
title: Calculate churn rate
